title: Sprint alignment cafe — cross-team leadership notes (2027-10-20)
content:
Meeting: Sprint alignment cafe (cross-team leadership)
Date: 2027-10-20
Time: 10:00 - 11:00 PT (60 min) — rapid-fire format, standing cafe vibe
Location: Zoom + #platform-leads slack thread
Facilitator: Aisha K. Patel
Attendees: Aisha K. Patel, Marcus L. Chen, Sofia R. Gomez, Ethan V. Li, Claire H. Novak, Priya Das (SRE), Tony M. Ruiz (Serving Runtime), Lena Park (Private Deployments)

Purpose and format:
- Quick alignment across platform, serving, SRE, and private deployments for the upcoming sprint slice.
- Each lead gives a 5–7 minute update: current sprint health, major risks, 1 ask/cross-team dependency.
- Record decisions and concrete action items with owners and due dates.

Executive summary:
- Runtime 7.2 canary progressing but EU latency spike discovered after kernel patch; canary paused in eu-west-1 pending root-cause.
- Autoscaler regression in Dedicated causing underutilization for a subset of pools — urgent follow-up with infra team.
- Cost optimization pilot (dynamic batching) shows potential 18–24% token-cost reduction for high-throughput customer workloads.
- Private deployment migration checklist updated; one enterprise customer (Acme Health) has an upcoming staged cutover Nov 10.

Updates by lead (rapid-fire):
1) Serving Runtime — Tony M. Ruiz
- Status: Canary rollout 7.2 started 2027-10-18; healthy in us-west, paused in eu-west due to 95th percentile latency jump +8ms on tail after kernel update.
- Investigation notes: tail latency correlated with a change to fused attention kernel scheduling (PR #1142). Reproduced with synthetic traces.
- Ask: Request SRE pair with runtime team to run targeted canary in eu-west with enhanced tracing (A: Priya).
- Related artifacts: PR #1142, ENG-4823.

2) Platform Engineering — Marcus L. Chen
- Status: Reserved-capacity autoscaler smoke tests failing for pools that mix quantized and full-precision models. Failure mode: scale-down triggers before request drain complete.
- Impact: degraded throughput for a subset of Dedicated customers (observed 2 customer incidents this week).
- Ask: Blocker requires infra engineering and SRE to collaborate on drain timeout heuristics and add a short-term guardrail. Open ticket INF-6017.

3) Observability & Ops — Sofia R. Gomez
- Status: New tracing dashboards deployed; can now slice token latency by kernel variant and quantization path. Helps isolate regression.
- Action: Deploy dashboard link to all runtime leads; set up weekly signal emails.
- Ask: Can product owners report 3 representative workloads for QA replay to validate fixes.

4) Private Deployments — Lena Park
- Status: Migration checklist revised; added KMS rotation step and on-prem test harness. Customer Acme Health scheduled staging cutover 2027-11-10.
- Risk: On-prem HSM integration has unpredictable throughput in lab; needs integration testing.
- Ask: Request dedicated test coord between private deployments and serving runtime for Nov 2–6 window.

5) SRE — Priya Das
- Status: On-call rotations adjusted to cover canary escalations; created temporary paging rule for kernel-related tail latency.
- Action: Prepped runbook for kernel-induced regressions.
- Ask: Need runtime team to finalize mitigation toggle by EOD 2027-10-21.

6) Cost & Performance (Optimize) — Ethan V. Li
- Status: Dynamic batching pilot completed stage 1; simulated runs show 18–24% token cost savings for customer segments with steady request patterns (batchable).
- Next: Start canary customers (2 customers) for live traffic trials starting 2027-10-25.
- Ask: Platform to enable batching opt-in flag in Dedicated pools for pilot customers.

Decisions made:
- Pause 7.2 canary in eu-west until root cause traced to kernel scheduling. (Owner: Tony; Target: 2027-10-21)
- Add drain-time guardrail to autoscaler as a high-priority hotfix for Dedicated pools. (Owner: Marcus + INF team; Target: 2027-10-22)
- Proceed with cost pilot canary for two low-risk customers after platform enables batching opt-in. (Owner: Ethan; Target: 2027-10-25)
- Private deployment migration: schedule cross-team integration window 2027-11-02 — 2027-11-06. (Owner: Lena)

Risks and blockers:
- Kernel patch root cause (high severity): blocks EU canary and may affect more regions if not contained.
- Autoscaler drain behavior causing customer-impact incidents — elevated priority.
- HSM throughput unpredictability in lab for private deployments — could delay Acme Health cutover.

Action items (concrete):
- A1: Runtime + SRE run enhanced tracing on eu-west canary and produce RCA draft. Owner: Tony M. Ruiz + Priya Das. Due: 2027-10-21. Linked: ENG-4823.
- A2: Infra to implement temporary drain-time guardrail and roll hotfix to Dedicated pools. Owner: Marcus L. Chen. Due: 2027-10-22. Linked: INF-6017.
- A3: Platform to add batching opt-in flag and enable for pilot customers; coordinate with Optimize team. Owner: Ethan V. Li + Platform lead. Due: 2027-10-24.
- A4: Private deployments + runtime to run end-to-end HSM throughput tests in lab; log results and mitigation plan. Owner: Lena Park. Due: 2027-10-29.
- A5: Observability to finalize kernel-variant dashboards and add alerts for tail-latency delta >5ms. Owner: Sofia R. Gomez. Due: 2027-10-23.
- A6: Product owners to provide 3 representative workloads for QA replay to validate runtime fix. Owner: Product-hosted-api (action assigned to product leads). Due: 2027-10-22.

Parking lot / follow-ups:
- Revisit autoscaler long-term design: avoid mixing quantized and fp pools or improve drain semantics. Assign to infra architecture working group.
- Longitudinal cost-vs-latency study for dynamic batching in mixed-latency SLAs.

Notes / Observations from discussion:
- Quick experiments: rollback kernel scheduling change on a canary node reproduced baseline latencies — suggests scheduling change as likely culprit.
- Short-term mitigation idea: increase KV cache prefetch window to reduce cache misses while kernel scheduling fix is developed.
- Leadership consensus: prioritize customer impact first (autoscaler hotfix), then kernel fix to restore canary in eu-west.

Next steps and next meeting:
- Next alignment cafe: 2027-10-27, same time, focus: canary RCA status, autoscaler hotfix rollout, batching pilot readiness.
- Deliverable before next meeting: RCA draft and hotfix plan (Tony + Marcus).

Appendix: relevant links and quick references
- ENG-4823 — Runtime kernel scheduling regression
- INF-6017 — Dedicated autoscaler drain-time regression
- Runtime 7.2 canary dashboard: https://observability.redwood.com/dashboards/runtime-7-2-canary
- Private deploy migration checklist (v3): https://confluence.redwood.com/display/OPS/Private+Deploy+Migration+Checklist+v3

Prepared by: Aisha K. Patel
Notes captured in quick-cafe style; please update Jira/Confluence tickets with any changes.
short_description: Cross-team sprint alignment notes focusing on Runtime 7.2 canary pause, autoscaler drain guardrail, and batching cost pilot. Includes decisions and action items.
